rationale: generateETag is the closure returned by createETagGenerator, which is assigned to exports.etag and exports.wetag (utils.js:40,51). The tests call it directly as utils.etag(...) (test/utils.js:9 onward). At runtime it flows through compileETag into app.set('etag fn', ...) (application.js:365) and is invoked as etagFn(chunk, encoding) in response.js:188. Both are real callers that depend on tracking a factory's returned function; no in-scope rule covers this. The generateETag references in response.js are to an unrelated local boolean.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The two fp-novel priors are correct. The tp prior correctly spotted the same-name boolean collision but then ignored the real invocations through exports.etag/wetag and the 'etag fn' setting.
